scope: Existing-data audit; no new workload experiments. The separate deadline campaign remains one repeat / 120 episodes and awaits SEA recovery.

power.interpretation: Coding-path incremental power is not a universal H100 ceiling. Historical Qwen/Gemma conditions reach near400W, but do not prove optimized GPT or net fleet savings. Destination additional energy must be included.

capacity.runtime: vLLM0.22.0 / LMCache0.5.1; compiled TRITON_ATTN; max_num_seqs256; max_num_batched_tokens8192; prefix cache on; engine_driven KV consumer
limitations: Finite Poisson arrival bursts followed to completion, not a sustained boundary.
realized_rps is observed arrival rate; finite_episode_completion_rps separately includes draining and is also not sustained capacity.
Fixed forced-length output; not full coding/long-context/agentic trace playback with location weights and tool delays.
No power traces in this optimized RPS run.
Current compact migration uses vLLM0.24.0, eager scheduling,8 sequences and lmcache_driven; do not transfer capacity between configurations.

loaded_migration.reuse: Observed resident response latency, action decisions, actual requests/wire bytes, coarse power before and during migration.
limits: Different workload/runtime/routes/state representation from target optimized SEA experiment.
Policies admit different migration populations; this is not an equal-work four-action causal comparison.
No matched no-migration control or end-to-end request-ID-linked queue/install/catch-up spans.
Independent source background traffic is not the set of histories being drained; power changes do not establish causal source relief.
Legacy 604/64 background generator has eight workers, so generated load is capped, not unlimited open-loop sustained capacity.

compact_kv.reuse: Actual compact payload/wire bytes, end-to-end readiness/TTFT and cached-prefix service validation.
limits: No destination resident traffic in these gates or d19.
d19 source load0.8 is modeled; no real source serving stream in drain design.
Source sleep timestamps in d19 are null; modeled shed watts are not measured active-to-idle transitions.
Qwen matches full-history restoration; cold-replay equivalence fails for aligned cases and remains an explicit limitation.
Export, network, installation and catch-up are not all separately request-correlated.

conclusions.eight_gpu: No matching eight-active-GPU H100 node evidence found. Single-H100-per-host data does not validate shared-NIC/staging/host-power scaling.

telemetry.collector: migration_profiler.PowerSampler queries nvidia-smi power.draw; logs monotonic_ns/wall_ns after query, watts, utilization, device framebuffer usage. Historical phase samplers also use power.draw.
telemetry.sensor: NVML power usage on H100 returns a one-second average; polling at0.1/0.25s is not equivalent sensor resolution.
missing: Power field/sensor averaging provenance per historical trace
Cumulative energy counters in historical traces
Per-sample GPU UUID, clocks and enforced cap
Per-host clock error bounds for cross-host alignment

capability_probe.scope: Single read-only probe; API support confirmed, update cadence/accuracy not validated.

extraction.latency: Successful end-start response latency. before_arrival cohort starts in the30s preceding migration; its crossover count shows requests affected by both phases. completed-before latency is also retained but is survivor-biased. During cohort starts inside migration and is followed through completion; failures reported separately. Do not compare these as randomized treatment effects.
extraction.power: Arithmetic means of valid samples in30s prewindow or migration window. Source wall-minus-monotonic offset maps source event windows to remote wall timestamps. Explicit stack_id preferred when present; legacy traces match unique source coverage. Clock offset spread and sample-span coverage retained; cross-host clock error not verified. No instantaneous energy or source/net saving inferred. memory.used is sampled device framebuffer usage, not live allocator occupancy or an exact temporary-buffer peak.

proposed_next_measurements.status: Design only; not launched and does not increase the one-repeat deadline sweep.
proposed_next_measurements.priority0: Freeze one optimized GPT runtime with compact-KV correctness validated; record loaded idle, decode, prefill-heavy and mixed steady serving plus active-to-awake-idle transitions. Establish low-load and near-boundary points on that exact runtime using actual trace arrivals, location weights and tool delays.

Mixed with one migration is impossible under per-session action selection; excluding those36 cells yields252 meaningful episodes. Keep mixed in the16-migration slice.
required_events: Stable request/session/migration IDs; scheduled arrival, send, queue admission, execution start, first token, token events, completion/error/unfinished
Export start/end with actual state geometry; per-flow transfer start/end/bytes; install start/end; replay start/end; catch-up and first successful destination service
Continued resident traffic and migrated session placement; preserve tool delays; stop source work only at actual handoff
All three GPUs: power average/instant, energy counters, sample/query timestamps, GPU UUID, clocks, cap, allocated/peak HBM and engine occupancy
Net power = matched no-migration total GPU watts minus action total GPU watts; compare energy over common windows and through completion. Separate GPU board energy from host energy.
proposed_next_measurements.validation: Three independent repetitions; hold out complete episodes; preserve failures/deadline misses; continue arrivals through claimed deadline and follow unfinished work to completion. Eight-GPU node measurement remains a separate required scale validation.
